title: Two Men Were Found Dead On A Brazilian Hillside Wearing Lead Masks. Nobody Knows Why.
description:
In 1966, two electronics technicians were found dead outside Rio de Janeiro, dressed in suits and wearing handmade lead masks over their eyes. Investigators never determined how they died.

#shorts #truestory #unsolvedmystery
sources: Dangerous Minds' account, "Be at the specified location: The baffling lead mask mystery of 1966"
The Cold File's coverage, "The Masks on Vintem Hill: The Lead Masks Case, 1966"

scenes.text: In August of 1966, two men were found dead on a hillside outside Rio de Janeiro, wearing suits and handmade lead masks over their eyes.
Manoel Pereira da Cruz and Miguel Jose Viana were electronics technicians, last seen alive on 17/08/1966, heading out on what they'd called a work trip.

Days later, a boy flying a kite found their bodies on Morro do Vintem. No visible wounds, just a notebook with a cryptic note: swallow capsules, then wait for the mask signal. No capsules were ever found.
Robbery was ruled out fast. Both men still had cash hidden in their clothes, completely untouched.
By the time of the autopsy weeks later, the bodies had decomposed too far to test for poison. The cause of death was never determined.

The leading theories: a radio operation gone wrong, or a spiritist ritual, with the masks meant to block an expected blinding light. A local resident even reported a glowing orange light over the hill that night.
Which theory do you find most convincing here -- a spiritist ritual, a radio operation gone wrong, or something else entirely?
